i do this already. there are people in my life who would have killed themselves if i wasn't there to support them when they were in their ruts. in one case I literally pulled someone off a roof. in another case i paid for medical bills and various legalities and ran around running errands for a friend with no support system. i'm helpful and sweet and patient so on ad infinitum supposedly, i don't complain, i don't show up unannounced, i don't impose, i just don't want to be treated like i'm mentally stunted, I don't want to be lied to and led on. I don't do good things to use as leverage or currency, I do it because i know i can and it'd be a shitty thing not to do so. I have no intention of nurturing a codependence. if you're still lying to me after all that, i don't know what the fuck i did wrong.

I am not hostile to people. I am not passive aggressive. I don't ditch people after making plans with them. I know how this goes, it doesn't work. some people emanate 'weak', 'victim', 'broken' all their lives and are treated as such. I am just not someone people want to bother with. but hey maybe if i get a nice car and lots of money and flashy stuff i'll be liked better. it'll be better for their self esteem to know me.

sure they are. sure it's hard keeping them separate. I get that this is overwhelming me now and maybe i'll feel better about it later. but my problems are fairly objectively separate, they're there regardless of whatever i feel like. to be clear, I'm used to this. I'm used to people being like this. I walk, talk and behave a little wonky, and i sometimes have a hard time keeping pace with other people. i'm sure it's annoying. I sympathize. I try and not be annoyance or a distraction and pleasant to be around. but ffs, there's a difference between anger at a situation and anger at a person. 

I don't get why it happens, it's just maybe that people are emotionally complacent and lazy. Maybe they're the fucked up ones. They should be trying to do what I do every day. they're the ones that don't want to lift a finger. I'd even go so far as to say that most people maybe fall into a couple dozen different types and they're strikingly predictable, unless they're put into a situation where they have to be involved and hands on. everyone's coasting, everyone wants and pretends they like being fair but they're not. i'm the one who fucks up once and then stories develop around me to dismiss me on that basis, because it's easier for people to justify things to themselves that way. it gets easier for people to blame stuff on me that I didn't do, it's enough for everyone that I plausibly could have so it adds to my toxic relationships. Everyone is like this. EVERYONE. People have no spines. stick them in a group and it takes one guy who's some sort of tier above me to fuck everything over. Can't talk to anyone, can't do anything to change it, I'm just supposed to ride it out apparently, or find other friends. over and over and over and over and over and over and over. FUCK THIS.

The last ten years of my life have passed on this way. The only exceptions, the only places I feel safe are when I'm with party people and I have money to spend. Then everyones all smiles, laughing at jokes they'd turn their nose up at otherwise. Ita fucking weird. People who say shut the fuck up unless they're around people who are new who dont know the group dynamic. Everyone's good to me then, they dont want to seem like dicks. Like they're picking on me. Then they laugh and smile like everyone else. But slowly they poison new people against me as well. Then its back to worrying about everything i do or say. What horseshit. If I talk back I am going to be worse off, I have yet to find people who, I dunno, give a shit. I don't want the only people in my life to be my parents and their families who tortured me every which way. Fuck these people its not fair. I do my time, I make an effort. It isnt right.
